books.title: Phineas Redux
books.author: Anthony Trollope
books.synopsis: Phineas Finn returns to Parliament only to be framed for the murder of his rival Mr. Bonteen, and Trollope turns the back half of his Palliser series into a courtroom drama, with Madame Max Goesler racing to dig up the evidence that saves Phineas from the gallows.

books.title: The Duke's Children
books.author: Anthony Trollope
books.synopsis: Widowed Duke of Omnium Plantagenet Palliser tries to steer his three grown children away from marriages and habits he can't control: son Silverbridge switches political parties, wrecks money on a crooked racehorse partnership, and falls for an American commoner, Isabel Boncassen; daughter Mary refuses every suitor but the penniless Frank Tregear; and Gerald gambles his way out of Cambridge. The Duke's resistance crumbles chapter by chapter until he gives his blessing to the matches he once forbade.

books.title: Demos
books.author: George Gissing
books.synopsis: A working-class London radical unexpectedly inherits a Midlands ironmaster's fortune and land, and tries to build a socialist industrial community on it while his own vanity, an unhappy marriage of convenience, and old class loyalties corrode the project from within; his sudden violent death hands the estate back to the dispossessed gentry heir, who quietly undoes the socialist scheme and wins the woman his rival had married for status.

books.title: Born in Exile
books.author: George Gissing
books.synopsis: A brilliant, poor young scientist fakes a religious conversion to court a clergyman's daughter and buy his way into respectable society, but his hidden contempt for the faith he's performing eats at him until the deception collapses and strips him of the life he engineered. He drifts abroad in disgrace and dies alone, far from home.

books.title: The Black Robe
books.author: Wilkie Collins
books.synopsis: Wealthy, guilt-haunted Lewis Romayne kills a man in a duel and becomes the target of Father Benwell, a Jesuit who schemes to steer Romayne's fortune and his troubled marriage to Stella Eyrecourt toward the Church. Benwell's manipulations, built on a hidden connection between Stella and the dead man's widow, drive Romayne from his wife and child into the priesthood, wrecking the marriage he swore to protect.

books.title: Hereward the Wake
books.author: Charles Kingsley
books.synopsis: Hereward, exiled for his wild youth, fights as a mercenary across Flanders and Ireland before storming home when the Normans conquer England. He rallies Saxon outlaws in the Fens around Ely for a doomed guerrilla war against William the Conqueror, and ends his life broken and half-forgotten, a last relic of the England that vanished with Harold at Hastings.
